title: Preference Data Selection for Mitigating the Alignment Tax in Large Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.24192v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Aligning large language models to human preferences is crucial for real-world deployment but frequently incurs an alignment tax, leading to the catastrophic forgetting of pre-trained general capabilities. While previous works primarily frame this problem as an optimization or architectural challenge, the inherent characteristics of preference data that drive this degradation remain largely underexplored. In this paper, we propose BALIGN, a balanced data selection strategy that explicitly mitigates catastrophic forgetting while optimizing alignment efficacy. Through theoretical and empirical analyses of the preference optimization gradient, we identify three key data-centric features that dictate parameter drift: the reference model's log-probability margin, the token length difference between chosen and rejected responses, and the TF-IDF similarity to general capability corpora. translated_title: 缓解大语言模型对齐税中的偏好数据选择策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.24192v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：将大语言模型与人类偏好对齐对于实际部署至关重要，但常常会引发对齐税，导致预训练通用能力的灾难性遗忘。虽然以往研究主要将此问题视为优化或架构挑战，但驱动这种退化过程的偏好数据固有特征仍未得到充分探索。在本文中，我们提出BALIGN，一种平衡的数据选择策略，旨在明确缓解灾难性遗忘，同时优化对齐效果。通过对偏好优化梯度的理论和实证分析，我们识别出决定参数漂移的三个关键数据中心特征：参考模型的对数概率边际、选定与拒绝响应之间的令牌长度差异，以及与通用能力语料库的TF-IDF相似度。通过将这些正交特征聚合为一个统一指标，我们提出了一种高效的数据选择方法，在多个基准测试中显著优于现有基线，在保持通用能力的同时实现卓越的对齐性能，展示了数据选择作为应对对齐税的有效工具的潜力。
tldr: 本文提出BALIGN，一种基于偏好数据三个关键特征（对数概率边际、令牌长度差异和TF-IDF相似度）的平衡选择策略，在提升对齐效果的同时有效缓解大语言模型的灾难性遗忘。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes BALIGN, a balanced data selection strategy based on three key data-centric features (log-probability margin, token length difference, and TF-IDF similarity), which effectively mitigates catastrophic forgetting while enhancing alignment performance in large language models.
